# derived from monero v0.18.5.1 source, not captured from a run
# fields: COMMAND_RPC_GET_ADDRESS::response_t, src/wallet/wallet_rpc_server_commands_defs.h:151-160
#         { address string, addresses[] = address_info (:136-149) }
#         address_info = { address string, label string, address_index u32, used bool }
# `address` is the PRIMARY address of the requested account -- upstream's own comment at :153 is
#         "to remain compatible with older RPC format". addresses[0] is the same string with
#         address_index 0.
# NO status/untrusted: the wallet RPC has no rpc_response_base.
# request: { account_index u32, address_index[] vector<u32> } (:125-133); an empty address_index
#         returns every generated subaddress of the account.
# THIS CALL IS THE SOURCE OF THREE THINGS, which is why it is on DESIGN.md §5's hot path:
#   1. status.wallet.primary_address = this `address` (public by construction, not a secret, §2b)
#   2. status.wallet.subaddress_count = addresses.len() = 3 here -- EVERY generated subaddress, not
#      just the funded ones. get_balance.json's per_subaddress has ONE entry; using its length would
#      report 1 for this wallet and 0 for a freshly restored one (§5).
#   3. THE WALLET'S OWN NETTYPE, the §2a.6 send-path authority: wallet_session::open records
#      address::parse(get_address{account}.address)?.net, never settings.node.network. All three
#      addresses here are mainnet, so that parse yields NetType::Mainnet.
# addresses are real, checksum-valid mainnet vectors from upstream's own test suite:
#   index 0 (standard,   prefix 18) tests/functional_tests/validate_address.py:68
#   index 1 (subaddress, prefix 42) tests/functional_tests/validate_address.py:73
#   index 2 (subaddress, prefix 42) tests/functional_tests/validate_address.py:74
# index 0 matches get_balance.json's per_subaddress[0].address byte for byte; index 1 matches it too
#         in kind (both prefix 42) but carries no balance row, which is the join §7a's Wallet screen
#         must render as an em dash. index 2 is `used: false` -- a generated but never-paid-to
#         subaddress, the state a fresh `wallet new-address` leaves behind.
# labels: index 0's is wallet2's own default for account 0 ("Primary account"); a subaddress with no
#         label carries the empty string, not null.
